Production Teardown returns document errors and uses one caller budget; startFinish joins close/document/runtime completion before publication. A caller deadline never establishes writer-joined proof or clears unreleased owner. Exact owner/generation guards preserve new contexts from old limiter callbacks. Initialization errors occur before monitor/worker startup; capability loss has no ordinary-Close success fallback.

Namespace descriptors plus cross-process locks, private initial raw file, atomic synced scrubbed hard-link publication, exact identity-bound retirement records, interrupted cleanup proofs, bounded scans/admission and revalidation remain intact. Legacy raw files do not become deletion candidates via age/PID/path alone. Completed flat/ledger duplicate planning requires inode equality; own batch cursor mutations do not adopt externally replaced ledger or payload.

Run resource readers use durable test/project authority, materialized archive lease and manifest-selected JSONL/Parquet transaction files. HAR staging/flat retention cannot select run resource files. Resource reader holds exact artifact, joins cancellation close, verifies final manifest/inode/pointer/project authorization, and releases lease after response. Native metrics/HAR closure do not turn retained resource observations into complete capture coverage or change summary-only availability semantics.
